properties.name: trivia.api.base-url
properties.description: The base url for the OpenTDB API.

properties.name: trivia.api.rate-limit
properties.description: The minimum required time between requests to the trivia API, written in ISO-8601 duration format.

properties.name: trivia.feature.ttl
properties.description: The maximum allowed time for a question-UUID & answer pair to stay in the cache, written in ISO-8601 duration format.

properties.name: trivia.feature.cache-limit
properties.description: The maximum allowed number of question-UUID & answer pairs to stay in the cache.
